entries.title: Disagree Politely in British English
entries.hook: Clear disagreement does not need to sound hostile.

turns.speaker: mia
turns.text: I see your point about launching quickly, but I’m not convinced Friday gives us enough testing time.

turns.speaker: leo
turns.text: Fair concern. What would you suggest?

turns.speaker: mia
turns.text: Could we test through Monday and launch on Tuesday?

turns.speaker: leo
turns.text: Partial agreement, one precise concern, and a workable alternative.

entries.prompt: What three moves made the disagreement useful?
entries.answer: Partial agreement, a precise concern, and an alternative.
entries.visualBrief: Bright polished anime office with two adult British colleagues in a calm discussion, shoulders-up, hands out of frame, teal navy and amber palette, no readable text.

entries.title: When Someone Says We Need to Talk
entries.hook: Someone says, ‘We need to talk.’ What should you ask first?

turns.speaker: mia
turns.text: We need to talk when you get home.

turns.speaker: leo
turns.text: Okay. Can you tell me roughly what it’s about, so I don’t worry about the wrong thing?

turns.speaker: mia
turns.text: It’s about the weekend plans. Nothing dangerous.

entries.answer: The general topic, or scope, of the conversation.
entries.visualBrief: Warm bright anime apartment scene with two adult partners having a calm serious conversation, chest-up, hands hidden, rust navy and cream palette, no readable text.

entries.title: What Does ‘Not Entirely Convinced’ Mean?
entries.hook: Your manager is ‘not entirely convinced.’ Is the plan approved?

turns.speaker: narrator
turns.text: There’s something in the proposal, but I’m not entirely convinced by a national launch. Could we test it in two cities first?

turns.speaker: narrator
turns.text: The whole idea is not rejected. The manager supports a smaller pilot before a national launch.

entries.prompt: Reject everything, approve everything, or request a smaller test?
entries.visualBrief: Polished bright anime presentation room with one adult professional considering two abstract map options, upper body only, hands out of frame, cobalt teal and gold, no readable text.

entries.title: Stop Solving an Imaginary Conversation
entries.hook: One vague message can make your brain write a disaster film.

turns.speaker: narrator
turns.text: Nora received, ‘We need to talk tonight,’ and immediately predicted the relationship was ending.

turns.speaker: narrator
turns.text: The fact was smaller: someone wanted a conversation. The prediction was not evidence.

turns.speaker: narrator
turns.text: She asked for the topic and time, then waited for the real words.

entries.answer: What you know from what you are predicting.
entries.visualBrief: Expressive bright anime adult woman looking at a phone while imagined storm clouds dissolve into a calm speech bubble, shoulders-up, hands hidden, warm coral blue and cream, no readable text.
